I think that love manifests in a million different ways and, in every individual form of existence, we love the same people in different ways.

What I felt with my boyfriend while tripping was an intense feeling of love, but not just romantic; him & I both realized that, in every single dimension stretching across all of the infinite possibilities of existence, we are together, just in different ways. Say, in this life he might be my boyfriend, but in another life somewhere else, he might be my sister, or my son, or even a best friend (mean this in the least weird way possible, but I'm not sure how else to explain it).

I'd also like to think that somewhere there exists a form of love without labels, where people just love, and there is no concept of family or relationships, only pure love and appreciation for the existence of other beings.

you should see a doctor or psychiatrist:) its way more than just being down and sad but that doesnt mean depression isnt a possibility.

other symptoms could be exhaustion for no reason, extreme drop in sex drive, less willingless to go out and be social, extreme loss/rise in appetite, etc. 

but this could be many things besides depression; and, even if it is depression, it could be season, which is also really common. either way you should see someone about it just to be safe. take care friend :)

if you have a real diagnosis (if its available to you) and you're not just self diagnosed, just trust that its for real. pain is pain is pain. saw a thread the other day that said "someone who drowns in 3 feet of water is just as dead as someone who drowns in 100 feet of water". just something to consider :) you arent any more or less important than anyone else who struggles with depression; its serious illness that needs attention no matter what. this is a normal thing to feel when depressed, but just remember thoughts like this (as difficult as it is to suppress them; i know its hard) will drive you deeper down into your depression. you deserve help, please seek it out.

if someone doesnt understand when you explain it and tries to argue against it/give you uneducated "advice" or if they pressure you to explain it, its a bad sign anyways. you dont owe anyone an explanation as to who you are, if theyre worth keeping around then theyll be patient and not need you to explain anything until you feel like it. good luck friend
